content: The standard practice of wearing bicycle helmets can be promoted through various public awareness campaigns. These campaigns may involve public service announcements, articles in newspapers, and segments on radio and television news programs or talk shows. Additionally, they can include the distribution of printed materials such as brochures, posters, fact sheets, and other informational resources. Educational initiatives can also be implemented through schools, youth organizations, churches, and civic or business groups within the community. Establishing speakers' bureaus is an effective method to facilitate many of these activities, allowing for direct engagement and dissemination of information.
